description: Dataset of mountain car control trajectories where the car must reach a goal region on the hill. This variant uses power parameter 0.0008 for the actuation dynamics, making the task more challenging due to lower actuation power.

generation_parameters.goal: Navigate the car to reach the goal region centered at x = π/6

power.description: Actuation power parameter that scales the applied force in the dynamics equation: velocity += (force * power - 0.0025 * cos(3 * position)) * dt
power.note: Lower power (0.0008) makes the task harder compared to 0.001 variant

success_condition.description: Success is achieved when |position - π/6| < 0.05 AND |velocity| < 0.02

simulation_parameters.description: Simulation at 10 Hz (dt=0.1s), maximum 3000 timesteps (300 seconds)

position.description: Position of the car on the mountain terrain (x-coordinate)

limits.description: Hard position limits enforced by walls. Car can push against walls with non-zero velocity.
Hard velocity limits enforced by clamping

manifold_structure.description: The state space is 2D Euclidean R^2

sampling_strategy.description: Initial states sampled on a uniform grid covering the entire valid state space

position_range.description: Float32-safe limits to prevent exceeding [-2, 1] bounds

velocity_range.description: Float32-safe limits to prevent exceeding [-0.1, 0.1] bounds

float_precision.note: Initial states generated as float32 to match environment precision and avoid boundary violations

state_transformation.description: State is transformed before feeding to controller: [sin(position), cos(position), velocity]

position_limits.description: Position clamped to [-2, 1] when boundaries are reached. Velocity is NOT reset to zero, allowing the car to 'push against walls'.

velocity_limits.description: Velocity clamped to [-0.1, 0.1] through hard limits

file_naming.trajectories: sequence_{i}.txt where i is the trajectory index (0 to 23999)
file_naming.actions: actions_{i}.txt where i is the trajectory index (0 to 23999)
file_naming.values: values_{i}.txt where i is the trajectory index (0 to 23999)

notes: Each line in trajectory file represents one state at a simulation timestep (0.1s intervals)
First line is the initial state from the sampling grid
Last line is the final state after 3000 timesteps or earlier termination
Trajectory lengths are fixed at 3000 timesteps (300 seconds)
Actions and values files have same number of lines as trajectory files minus one (no action/value for final state)

roa_labels.txt.description: Region of attraction labels for trajectories - maps initial state to success label
roa_labels.txt.format: 2 comma-separated initial state values (position, velocity) followed by label (0 or 1)

success_criteria.combined: Both conditions must be satisfied for success

dataset_characteristics.terrain: Sinusoidal hills with height = sin(3 * x)
dataset_characteristics.goal_location: Right hill peak region near π/6 ≈ 0.524 rad
dataset_characteristics.challenge: Significantly underpowered system (power=0.0008) requiring careful momentum management
dataset_characteristics.difficulty: Higher than power=0.001 variant due to reduced actuation authority
dataset_characteristics.state_space_coverage: Complete uniform coverage of valid state space [-2, 1] × [-0.1, 0.1]
